n17dca967ce1.s: Which of the following WTO bodies is wrongly matched with its function?
o: General Council – Runs the WTO between Ministerial Conferences
Dispute Settlement Body – Deals with panel and Appellate Body rulings
Trade Policy Review Body – Highest decision-making body
n17dca967ce1.x: The Trade Policy Review Body conducts periodic reviews of members' trade policies; the Ministerial Conference is the highest decision-making body.

n5accf91798f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the WTO's 14th Ministerial Conference (Yaoundé, March 2026)?
o: No fisheries subsidies Phase 2 deal was reached
A permanent solution on public stockholding was agreed
n5accf91798f.x: MC14 ended without a permanent solution on public stockholding; both moratoria lapsed and no fisheries Phase 2 deal was reached.

n4a671235a9a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about WTO disputes involving India?
o: The USA challenged the JNNSM solar domestic-content rules and India lost in 2016
The EU, Japan and Chinese Taipei won a panel against India's ICT tariffs in 2023
The dispute over India's export subsidy schemes (MEIS, SEZ) was brought by the EU
The panel in the export subsidy (MEIS, SEZ) dispute ruled in 2019
n4a671235a9a.x: The MEIS/SEZ export subsidy case was brought by the USA, not the EU (panel 2019).

n79db418f342.s: The Uruguay Round (1986–1993/94), which led to the creation of the WTO, was the ____ round of GATT negotiations.
n79db418f342.x: The Uruguay Round was the eighth GATT round; it involved 123 countries and created the WTO.

n1b4752aa66c.s: The WTO moratorium on customs duties on electronic transmissions lapsed on:
n1b4752aa66c.x: The moratorium lapsed on 31 March 2026 after MC14 failed to extend it; 66 members then signed a plurilateral agreement banning such duties.

n66ab2eeb066.s: To meet its TRIPS obligations, India enacted the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act in:
n66ab2eeb066.x: The GI Act, 1999 was enacted to meet TRIPS obligations; the Patents Act was amended in 2005 for the same purpose.

n3ea7e56b76d.s: India opposes bringing which of the following plurilateral initiatives into the WTO rulebook?
n3ea7e56b76d.x: Investment Facilitation for Development, backed by more than 120 members, is a plurilateral initiative that India opposes bringing into the WTO rulebook.

nd1414bb0e4d.s: Which GATT Article permits free trade agreements as exceptions to the MFN principle, if they cover substantially all trade?
nd1414bb0e4d.x: GATT Article XXIV allows FTAs as MFN exceptions provided they cover substantially all trade.

ndf2a4f7c35e.s: Non-tariff barrier codes are associated with which GATT round?
ndf2a4f7c35e.x: Non-tariff barrier codes came from the Tokyo Round; the Uruguay Round produced TRIPS, GATS and the Agreement on Agriculture.

n067c2f222d3.s: Which GATT round was held during 1964–67?
n067c2f222d3.x: The Kennedy Round ran 1964–67; the Tokyo Round 1973–79, Uruguay 1986–93/94 and Doha was launched in 2001.

n45bf7e09abb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about BIMSTEC?
o: Each of its sectors has a lead country
Myanmar earlier led the energy sector
Its sectors were expanded from 7 to 14
n45bf7e09abb.x: BIMSTEC reduced its sectors from 14 to 7, not the other way round.

ncc7e37fd28a.s:
Assertion (A): The United Kingdom's withdrawal from the European Union (Brexit) was carried out under Article 50 of the Treaty on European Union.
Reason (R): Article 50 of the Treaty on European Union is the EU's exit clause.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncc7e37fd28a.x: Article 50 TEU is the withdrawal clause, and it was invoked for Brexit; the UK left on 31 January 2020.

n574c15f927a.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: ASEAN-India FTA in goods came into force – 2019
Review India sought at the 32nd ARF (2025) – RCEP review
n574c15f927a.x: The ARF dates from 1994. AIFTA (goods) came into force in 2010, India opted out of RCEP in 2019, and India sought early completion of the AITIGA review.

nf8d1fc8a893.s: The Council of Europe, founded in 1949, is headquartered at:
nf8d1fc8a893.x: The Council of Europe sits at Strasbourg; Brussels is the seat of the EU.

n9d9e30c7f2f.s: The BIMSTEC Charter was adopted at the 5th BIMSTEC Summit (2022) held at:
n9d9e30c7f2f.x: The Charter was adopted at the 5th Summit in Colombo (2022); the 6th Summit was at Bangkok in April 2025.

n5774aa914d8.s: With the admission of Timor-Leste in 2025, the membership of ASEAN became:
n5774aa914d8.x: Timor-Leste joined ASEAN in 2025, taking its membership to 11.

ndf0c9f526ca.s: Which two countries joined BIMSTEC in 2004?
ndf0c9f526ca.x: Nepal and Bhutan joined in 2004; BIMSTEC began in 1997 as BIST-EC with Bangladesh, India, Sri Lanka and Thailand.

n9af08d8c8e1.s: How many member states does the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA), formed in 1997, have?
n9af08d8c8e1.x: IORA, formed in 1997, has 23 member states.

naf0c245ac96.s: Which is the only ASEAN country that shares a land border with India?
naf0c245ac96.x: Myanmar is the only ASEAN country sharing a land border with India.

n236aee3db8f.s: 'Bangkok Vision 2030' belongs to which regional grouping?
n236aee3db8f.x: Bangkok Vision 2030 belongs to BIMSTEC; the South Asia Satellite and COVID emergency fund were India's SAARC initiatives.

ndaa8ea0066f.s: MILEX, the first BIMSTEC army exercise (2018), was held at:
ndaa8ea0066f.x: MILEX, the first BIMSTEC army exercise, was held at Pune in 2018.

nb57b7db1cf6.s:
Assertion (A): India is scheduled to chair BRICS in 2026, after Brazil in 2025.
Reason (R): The BRICS chairmanship rotates in the order B-R-I-C-S.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nb57b7db1cf6.x: The chair follows the B-R-I-C-S order: Russia (2024), Brazil (2025), India (2026).

n4116eaea164.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the origin of the G20 is correctly matched?
o: G7 summit that foreshadowed the G20 (June 1999) – Washington
Original G20 format (1999) – Heads of state and government
n4116eaea164.x: The first G20 meeting was at Berlin in December 1999. It was foreshadowed at the G7 Cologne summit, began as a finance ministers' forum, and leaders' summits started in 2008 at Washington.

ne62ef234512.s: Which of the following is an observer, not a member, of the Colombo Security Conclave?
ne62ef234512.x: Seychelles is an observer; India, Mauritius and Bangladesh are members.

nd313e2d1540.s: The first BRIC summit was held in 2009 at:
nd313e2d1540.x: The first BRIC summit was at Yekaterinburg, Russia, in 2009; BRIC was formalised in 2006 and South Africa joined in 2011.

nb11c8922f89.s: Which of the following is one of the five pillars of the Colombo Security Conclave?
nb11c8922f89.x: The five pillars are maritime safety and security, counter-terrorism and radicalisation, trafficking and organised crime, cyber security and critical infrastructure, and HADR.

n8e78d498af2.s: The BRICS Contingent Reserve Arrangement, created in 2014, has a liquidity pool of:
n8e78d498af2.x: The BRICS CRA (2014) has a liquidity pool of 100 billion dollars.

n98c86d1e78b.s: The Colombo Security Conclave began in 2011 as a maritime trilateral of India, Sri Lanka and:
n98c86d1e78b.x: The Colombo Security Conclave originated in 2011 as an India-Sri Lanka-Maldives maritime trilateral.

nf26b4870f69.s: Which of the following is wrongly matched?
o: MTCR – 1987 – Missiles and drones (500 kg over 300 km)
nf26b4870f69.x: The NSG (1975) controls nuclear materials and technology; missiles and drones fall under the MTCR (1987).

n40dd4c7c234.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the OPCW?
o: It implements the Chemical Weapons Convention
It is an institution of the European Union
It inspects the destruction of chemical weapons
It received the Nobel Peace Prize in 2013
n40dd4c7c234.x: The OPCW is not an EU body; it implements the CWC, monitors the chemical industry and won the 2013 Nobel Peace Prize.

n9f5595b86d0.s:
Assertion (A): Placement on the FATF grey list does not necessarily mean that a jurisdiction faces a call for action.
Reason (R): A call for action applies to the FATF black list of high-risk jurisdictions, while the grey list covers jurisdictions under increased monitoring.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n9f5595b86d0.x: The grey list means increased monitoring; a call for action characterises the black list, which explains why grey-listing alone does not mean a call for action.

nf2f2b417aae.s: India is party to how many of the protocols of the UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW)?
nf2f2b417aae.x: The CCW deals with inhumane conventional weapons, and India is party to all five of its protocols.

n2664d611632.s: India supports negotiation of the Fissile Material Cut-off Treaty (FMCT) at the:
n2664d611632.x: India supports FMCT negotiations at the Conference on Disarmament, for a treaty that does not cap existing stocks.

n73d76163c00.s: India joined the IAEA as a founding member in:
n73d76163c00.x: India joined the IAEA in 1957 as a founding member.

n7e9b30c9298.s: The NPT, which entered into force in 1970, was extended indefinitely in:
n7e9b30c9298.x: The NPT (signed 1968, in force 1970) was extended indefinitely in 1995.

n5d10041a5fa.s: India completed the destruction of its declared chemical-weapon stockpile under the CWC in:
n5d10041a5fa.x: India, a party to the CWC (in force 1997), completed destruction of its declared stockpile in 2009.

nbe3c331bb46.s: The Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons (TPNW) entered into force in:
nbe3c331bb46.x: The TPNW, a binding treaty banning nuclear weapons, entered into force in 2021.

nbf6f1efcec4.s: The secretariat of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) is located at:
nbf6f1efcec4.x: The FATF secretariat is at Paris (OECD); Vienna hosts the IAEA.

nafe87e8d106.s: Which pair of countries is outside both the Wassenaar Arrangement and the MTCR?
nafe87e8d106.x: China and Pakistan are outside both Wassenaar and the MTCR.

nd950c6f833f.s: India's Additional Protocol to its IAEA safeguards agreement came into force in:
nd950c6f833f.x: India's Additional Protocol came into force in 2014.

nd9cf68ba108.s:
Assertion (A): The Department of Peace Operations manages UN peacekeeping missions.
Reason (R): UN peacekeeping missions are funded through a separate peacekeeping assessment scale.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd9cf68ba108.x: Both are true, but the funding arrangement does not explain which department manages the missions.

ndcd20cc5bca.s: The L.M. Singhvi High Level Committee on the Indian Diaspora, set up in 2000, submitted its report in:
ndcd20cc5bca.x: The committee was set up in 2000 and reported in 2002; it recommended Pravasi Bharatiya Divas, first held in 2003.

n9f3f308c53e.s: Operation Kaveri was India's evacuation operation from:
n9f3f308c53e.x: Kaveri was the Sudan evacuation; Ajay was Israel, Ganga was Ukraine and Dost was the Türkiye-Syria earthquake relief.

n5e6ea7fc7cb.s: The UN peacekeeping mission MINUSTAH was in:
n5e6ea7fc7cb.x: MINUSTAH was in Haiti; UNMIL was in Liberia, UNMISET in Timor-Leste and UNIFIL in Lebanon.

n26ff87ea4d7.s: The Salma Dam, an Indian development partnership project, is located in:
n26ff87ea4d7.x: The Salma Dam and the Parliament building are in Afghanistan; Metro Express is in Mauritius.

na690d3e05fa.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's naval exercises and maritime platforms?
o: The 2022 and 2024 editions of MILAN were held at Visakhapatnam
AIKEYME stands for Africa-India Key Maritime Engagement
MILAN is a bilateral exercise of the Indian Navy
The first AIKEYME was held at Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, in 2025
na690d3e05fa.x: MILAN is a multilateral exercise hosted by the Indian Navy, not a bilateral one.

n03e20ff4875.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region)?
o: It aims to make India the net security provider in the Indian Ocean Region
It is seen as countering China's 'String of Pearls'
It widened India's maritime vision to the Indo-Pacific and the Global South
n03e20ff4875.x: Widening the vision to the Indo-Pacific and the Global South is MAHASAGAR (2025), not SAGAR.

n6dd74b11c59.s:
Assertion (A): The Information Fusion Centre - Indian Ocean Region (IFC-IOR), set up by the Indian Navy in December 2018, is located at Visakhapatnam.
Reason (R): IFC-IOR is meant for maritime domain awareness and information sharing.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n6dd74b11c59.x: IFC-IOR is at Gurugram, not Visakhapatnam, so A is false; R correctly states its purpose.

n7181eb55d2c.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the INSTC is correctly matched?
o: Original signatories – India, Iran and Russia
Route from Mumbai – Via Afghanistan to Central Asia
n7181eb55d2c.x: The 2000 INSTC agreement was signed by India, Iran and Russia; the route runs from Mumbai via Iran, and the western branch passes through Azerbaijan.

n98f74195787.s: The Indian Ocean Naval Symposium (IONS) was launched by the Indian Navy, with its first meeting in New Delhi, in:
n98f74195787.x: IONS was launched in 2008; the claim of an inaugural IONS in 2015 is a known trap.

n19b83cbaa9a.s: MAHASAGAR, which widens SAGAR to the Indo-Pacific and the Global South, was introduced in:
n19b83cbaa9a.x: MAHASAGAR was introduced in 2025, extending SAGAR (2015) to the Indo-Pacific and the Global South.

n3f1ded74d69.s: The India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) was announced in:
n3f1ded74d69.x: IMEC was announced in 2023; the INSTC agreement dates to 2000, the Ashgabat Agreement to 2011 and India joined Ashgabat in 2018.

n6fdd3b0e37c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS)?
o: The CDS heads the Department of Military Affairs
The CDS is the principal military adviser to the Prime Minister
The CDS is Permanent Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee
The CDS is military adviser to the Nuclear Command Authority
n6fdd3b0e37c.x: The CDS is principal military adviser to the Defence Minister, not the Prime Minister.

n0f832a9ac0a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Vibrant Villages Programme-II (VVP-II)?
o: It covers villages on the Pakistan, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Nepal and Bhutan borders
It covers Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Arunachal Pradesh, Sikkim and Ladakh
Its roads are built under PMGSY-IV
n0f832a9ac0a.x: The China-border states (HP, Uttarakhand, Arunachal, Sikkim, Ladakh) are covered by the first phase of the Vibrant Villages Programme, not VVP-II.

nfb26866a132.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: The NIA is a voluntary auxiliary force raised by the States
The NIA functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs
The NIA can investigate scheduled offences anywhere in India without State consent
Home Guards are voluntary auxiliary forces under the States
nfb26866a132.x: Home Guards, not the NIA, are voluntary auxiliary forces of the States; the NIA is a central agency under the MHA.

nf105d033001.s:
Assertion (A): The ITBP maintains border posts at altitudes ranging from 9,000 to 18,800 feet.
Reason (R): The ITBP guards the high-altitude China border from Karakoram Pass to Jachep La.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf105d033001.x: The ITBP, raised in 1962, guards the high-altitude China border from Karakoram Pass to Jachep La, which is why its posts lie at such altitudes.

n61d36bff250.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Research and Analysis Wing – Internal intelligence under the MHA
Intelligence Bureau – External intelligence under the Cabinet Secretariat
Research and Analysis Wing – External intelligence
n61d36bff250.x: RAW (1968) is India's external intelligence agency under the Cabinet Secretariat; the IB (1887) handles internal intelligence under the MHA.

nc32350b9d07.s: Which force protects the Prime Minister and former Prime Ministers?
nc32350b9d07.x: The SPG (SPG Act 1988) protects the PM and former PMs; the NSG ('Black Cats') is the MHA counter-terror force.

nb9b8234678b.s: The Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act was enacted in:
nb9b8234678b.x: UAPA was enacted in 1967 and amended in 2004, 2008, 2012 and 2019.

nfb2dee5dfb1.s: Which is India's oldest paramilitary force?
nfb2dee5dfb1.x: Assam Rifles (1835) is the oldest; the CRPF began in 1939 as the Crown Representative's Police.

n1db470944e0.s: The Coimbatore blasts took place in:
n1db470944e0.x: The Coimbatore blasts were in 1998, after the Rajiv Gandhi assassination (1991) and Mumbai blasts (1993) and before the Parliament attack (2001).

nec2976ecf8a.s: India shares its longest international land border with:
nec2976ecf8a.x: The Bangladesh border (4,096.7 km) is longer than the China (3,488 km), Pakistan (3,323 km) and Nepal (1,751 km) borders.

ndce4ebd3b62.s: In the three-tier coastal-security arrangement after 26/11, shallow waters are the responsibility of the:
ndce4ebd3b62.x: Coastal police cover shallow waters, the Coast Guard territorial waters, and the Navy has overall responsibility.

nindian-society-39-17.s: Which of the following is wrongly matched?
o: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao – Awareness and enforcement against female foeticide
Accessible India Campaign – Auditing and retrofitting of public spaces
Poshan Maah & Poshan Pakhwada – Auditing and retrofitting of public spaces
Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan – Community mobilisation in high-vulnerability districts
nindian-society-39-17.x: Poshan Maah and Poshan Pakhwada are bi-annual mass nutrition sensitisation drives; auditing and retrofitting public spaces is the Accessible India Campaign.

n4d6eb412cae.s: Which of the following pension schemes is wrongly matched with its beneficiaries?
o: Atal Pension Yojana – Unorganised workers with a bank account
PM-KMY – Traders with turnover up to ₹1.5 crore
PM-SYM – Unorganised workers earning up to ₹15,000 a month
NPS-Traders – Traders with turnover up to ₹1.5 crore
n4d6eb412cae.x: PM-KMY is for small and marginal farmers; traders are covered by NPS-Traders.

n78f5f430e59.s: Which of the following schemes is wrongly matched with its objective?
o: Ujjwala – Life and disability cover for rural landless households
Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana – Life and disability cover for rural landless households
n78f5f430e59.x: Ujjwala provides free LPG connections to BPL women; life and disability cover is the Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana.

n11912432dd0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Code on Social Security, 2020?
o: It is the first law to recognise aggregators, gig workers and platform workers
Aggregators must contribute 1–2 per cent of annual turnover to a social-security fund
There is no cap on the aggregators' contribution
The contribution is linked to the payments made to workers
n11912432dd0.x: The aggregator contribution is capped at 5 per cent of the payments made to workers.

n2965416d58c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Pension System (NPS)?
o: It is a defined-contribution pension system
Both Tier I and Tier II accounts are mandatory
An extra deduction of ₹50,000 is available under Section 80CCD(1B)
n2965416d58c.x: Tier I is mandatory but Tier II is voluntary.

n6d93f307d72.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Atal Pension Yojana (APY)?
o: Government support for it has been extended up to FY 2030–31
Its eligible entry age is 18 to 60 years
n6d93f307d72.x: The eligible entry age for APY is 18 to 40 years.

n595e641690e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the senior citizen expansion of PM-JAY?
o: It is limited to senior citizens aged 70 or above who are below the poverty line
It is known as Ayushman Vay Vandana
A family already covered gets a ₹5 lakh top-up for the eligible senior citizen
n595e641690e.x: Every person aged 70 or above is eligible irrespective of income.

n4628b975f83.s:
Assertion (A): The SEED scheme provides PM-JAY coverage and PMAY housing support to Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes.
Reason (R): SEED is administered by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n4628b975f83.x: Both are true: SEED is a Central Sector scheme of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment that includes PM-JAY and PMAY support, but the ministry running it does not explain what it provides.

necfc2cb74fb.s:
Assertion (A): Under the NSAP, the National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS) provides assistance on the death of a breadwinner aged 18–59.
Reason (R): Under the NSAP, IGNDPS covers persons with at least 80 per cent disability.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
necfc2cb74fb.x: Both are correct NSAP components, but the disability pension rule does not explain the family benefit scheme.

n263a2d017a2.s: The Employees' Provident Fund generally covers establishments employing ____ or more persons.
n263a2d017a2.x: EPF generally covers establishments with 20 or more employees, with 12% of wages contributed each by employee and employer.

n79f4f0962f7.s: Ayushman Bharat–PM-JAY was launched in September 2018 at:
n79f4f0962f7.x: PM-JAY, earlier called the National Health Protection Scheme, was launched at Ranchi in September 2018 and subsumed RSBY (2008).

n4be164957fe.s: e-Shram, the Aadhaar-verified National Database of Unorganised Workers, was launched on 26 August 2021 by the Ministry of:
n4be164957fe.x: e-Shram was launched by the Ministry of Labour and Employment and gives a 12-digit UAN; income-tax payers and EPFO/ESIC members are excluded.

n840bbeacb8a.s: Under Andhra Pradesh's NTR Bharosa scheme, the monthly pension is:
n840bbeacb8a.x: NTR Bharosa provides ₹4,000 per month; AP's Universal Health Policy gives ₹2.5 lakh free cover to all.

n894b5ffcb48.s: Under the National Food Security Act, priority households receive ____ of foodgrain per person per month.
n894b5ffcb48.x: Priority households get 5 kg per person per month; AAY households get 35 kg per household, and the maternity benefit is Rs 6,000.

n3626727b99a.s: PM-SYM covers unorganised workers earning up to ____ a month.
n3626727b99a.x: PM-SYM's income limit is Rs 15,000 a month; the Centre makes a 1:1 matching contribution.

n8f5f8efdfe8.s: The Jal Jeevan Mission (2019), which aims at a Functional Household Tap Connection for every rural home, is under the Ministry of:
n8f5f8efdfe8.x: The Jal Jeevan Mission was launched in 2019 under the Ministry of Jal Shakti; Village Water and Sanitation Committees plan and run the supply.

n99b440482c0.s: Samagra Shiksha (2018) covers school education from:
n99b440482c0.x: Samagra Shiksha covers pre-school to Class 12; NIPUN Bharat targets foundational literacy and numeracy by Grade 3.

ne357f8209cc.s: Under PMAY-Gramin, the unit assistance for a house in hilly areas is:
ne357f8209cc.x: PMAY-G gives Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly areas and Rs 1.20 lakh in plains, for a house of at least 25 sq m.

n06dedba1af2.s: Janani Suraksha Yojana, under the National Health Mission, provides cash assistance for:
n06dedba1af2.x: JSY gives cash assistance for institutional delivery under the NHM and is 100 per cent centrally sponsored.

nebdf1944be4.s: ILO Convention No. 102, the Social Security (Minimum Standards) Convention, 1952, sets minimum standards for how many branches of social security?
nebdf1944be4.x: Convention No. 102 covers nine branches of social security; India has not ratified it.

ncd0d97a313c.s: POSHAN Abhiyaan brings together ICDS, the National Health Mission and:
ncd0d97a313c.x: POSHAN Abhiyaan converges ICDS, NHM and Swachh Bharat to tackle stunting, under-nutrition, anaemia and low birth weight.

n8f50120d233.s: PMAY-Gramin has been extended up to:
n8f50120d233.x: PMAY-G has been extended to 2028-29, with 2 crore more houses for 2024-25 to 2028-29.

n71cde77f874.s: The two sub-missions of the National Health Mission are:
n71cde77f874.x: NHM has two parts, the National Rural Health Mission and the National Urban Health Mission, with ASHAs and ANMs as its backbone.

n6a1cc0d94a6.x: India was certified polio-free in 2014; Pulse Polio began in 1995.

nd6856755548.s: The e-Shram portal was launched in:
nd6856755548.x: e-Shram was launched on 26 August 2021; 2019 is the year of PM-SYM, PM-KMY and NPS-Traders.

nc02427f07eb.s: The Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission (target 2047) was launched in July 2023 at Shahdol in:
nc02427f07eb.x: Shahdol is in Madhya Pradesh; the mission aims to eliminate sickle cell anaemia by 2047.

n0c2415151bd.s: The national rollout of One Nation One Ration Card, which makes NFSA benefits portable across India, began in:

na18132d488c.s: Under the Code on Social Security, a creche is required in establishments with ____ or more employees.
na18132d488c.x: A creche is required at 50 or more employees; 20 is the EPF coverage threshold.

nad620e064ab.s: Antyodaya Anna Yojana, meant for the poorest of the poor, provides foodgrain of:
nad620e064ab.x: AAY gives 35 kg per household per month, not per person.

nindian-society-39-14.s: The lead ministry for Poshan Maah and Poshan Pakhwada is the Ministry of:
nindian-society-39-14.x: The Poshan campaigns run at village and Anganwadi level under the Ministry of Women and Child Development.

ne1840ae032b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about MPLADS?
o: It is administered by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Its unspent funds lapse at the end of each financial year
MPs recommend works, while the district authority executes them
It earmarks 15 per cent for SC areas and 7.5 per cent for ST areas

nindian-society-38-17.s: Which of the following portals is wrongly matched with its ministry?
o: National Cybercrime Reporting Portal – Home Affairs (I4C)
Skill India Digital Hub – Education (Higher Education)
PM-DevINE Portal – Development of North Eastern Region
nindian-society-38-17.x: The Skill India Digital Hub comes under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.

n98e61f08ce3.s:
Assertion (A): PMKVY 1.0 was launched in 2016.
Reason (R): PMKVY is the flagship of the Skill India Mission for short-term training and certification.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n98e61f08ce3.x: PMKVY 1.0 was launched in 2015 along with the Skill India Mission, so A is false; R is true.

nd2e555d14b8.s: PM SVANidhi is a scheme of the Ministry of:
nd2e555d14b8.x: PM SVANidhi is under MoHUA; PM Vishwakarma is under MSME and PM-AJAY under Social Justice and Empowerment.

ncb0115adafb.s: The Adarsh Gram component of PM-AJAY was formerly known as:
ncb0115adafb.x: The Adarsh Gram component was formerly PMAGY (2009-10); it covers villages with 500+ people and over 40% SC population.

n642f2bb4853.s: Under DAY-NRLM, Centre-State funding for North-Eastern States including Sikkim is in the ratio:
n642f2bb4853.x: DAY-NRLM is funded 60:40 generally and 90:10 for NE States including Sikkim; UTs get 100% Central funding.

n7fe3c91457b.s: Under MGNREGA, at least what share of the workers had to be women?
n7fe3c91457b.x: MGNREGA required one-third of workers to be women; the Gram Sabha ran the social audit.

n5a60462c305.s: Under PMFBY, the farmer premium for commercial and horticultural crops is:
n5a60462c305.x: The premium is 5% for commercial/horticultural crops, 2% for kharif and 1.5% for rabi.

n5c44960bdca.s: PM-KISAN, launched in February 2019, is funded as a:
o: Centrally Sponsored Scheme with a 60:40 share
Centrally Sponsored Scheme with a 75:25 share
Centrally Sponsored Scheme with a 90:10 share
n5c44960bdca.x: PM-KISAN is a 100% Central Sector scheme giving Rs 6,000 a year in three instalments.

nca67b70d842.s: PM-PRANAM, which aims to cut chemical fertiliser use, was launched in:
nca67b70d842.x: PM-PRANAM was launched in 2023; States share the subsidy saved.

n9556aaa4b17.s: The National Council for Land Reforms, set up in 2008, is chaired by the:
n9556aaa4b17.x: The National Council for Land Reforms (2008) is chaired by the Prime Minister.

n4776266588d.s: SVAMITVA, which uses drone surveys to give property cards for village houses, is a scheme of the Ministry of:
n4776266588d.x: SVAMITVA is under the Ministry of Panchayati Raj and was launched on 24 April 2020, National Panchayati Raj Day.

nc429be82419.s: VB-G RAM G, which replaces MGNREGA, guarantees how many days of work per household?
nc429be82419.x: VB-G RAM G raises the guarantee to 125 days and is implemented through Panchayati Raj Institutions.

nda67739feea.s: Under VB-G RAM G, the unemployment allowance and delay compensation are borne by:
nda67739feea.x: Under VB-G RAM G these are borne fully by the States; under MGNREGA the allowance was due if work was not given within 15 days.

nd2c18efaf1f.s: The VB-G RAM G Act came into force on:
nd2c18efaf1f.x: It was introduced on 16 December 2025, got assent on 20 December 2025, was notified on 11 May 2026 and commenced on 1 July 2026.

nf8dd6afba07.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about MUDRA?
o: Its nodal ministry is the Ministry of MSME
Its stated aim is to 'fund the unfunded'
nf8dd6afba07.x: MUDRA's nodal ministry is the Ministry of Finance.

n088fd64458f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about UDAN?
o: It is a freight-only railway programme
n088fd64458f.x: UDAN is an air-connectivity scheme, not a freight railway programme.

n182887da440.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: SIDBI – Fund of Funds for Startups
n182887da440.x: IREDA is the renewable-energy financing arm; Bharatmala is associated with NHAI.

n68f54f5b8ca.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the National Green Hydrogen Mission?
o: It received Cabinet approval in January 2023
Its nodal ministry is the Ministry of Power
n68f54f5b8ca.x: The nodal ministry is the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).

nd4ad04d526d.s:
Assertion (A): Aadhaar is a 12-digit number that was started in 2009.
Reason (R): UIDAI functions under the National Food Security Act, 2013.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd4ad04d526d.x: A is true; R is false because UIDAI works under the Aadhaar Act, 2016 (amended 2019).

n25a03e4ba54.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n25a03e4ba54.x: EESL implements UJALA; REC is the nodal agency for DDUGJY and Saubhagya, and KVIC handles PMEGP and Solar Charkha.

n7b6d340ddf8.s: The IndiaAI Mission, approved in March 2024, has an approved outlay of about:
n7b6d340ddf8.x: IndiaAI's outlay is about Rs 10,372 crore for compute, datasets and AI innovation; fab and ATMP incentives belong to the India Semiconductor Mission.

ncefcc597ce1.s: PM-DevINE, a fully centrally funded scheme of the Ministry of DoNER, was announced in the Union Budget of:
ncefcc597ce1.x: PM-DevINE was announced in Union Budget 2022-23.

n56658fcbdcf.s: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme covers how many sectors?
n56658fcbdcf.x: PLI, a Central Sector scheme, covers 14 sectors such as electronics, pharma, telecom and auto components.

nfb2433aaf33.s: The Solar Charkha Mission (2018) of the Ministry of MSME is implemented through:
nfb2433aaf33.x: It is implemented through KVIC and sets up solar-powered spinning and weaving clusters for rural artisans.

n6a8d91738af.x: Digital India came in 2015, after Make in India (2014) and before Startup India (2016) and Atmanirbhar Bharat (2020).

n406880e6da2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about minority welfare in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Pilgrimage assistance is limited to Haj only
Imams and Mouzams receive ₹5,000–10,000 per month
The annual expenditure on this assistance is ₹180 crore
Urdu is the second official language of the State
n406880e6da2.x: Pilgrimage assistance covers both Haj and Jerusalem.

n455f24827a8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's Stree Shakti scheme?
o: Free travel is available in all APSRTC bus categories without exception
It was later extended to persons with disabilities
Women's share of bus travel rose from 40% to 65%
n455f24827a8.x: Free travel covers 5 APSRTC bus categories, not all.

n704d9453805.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's Disha Bill, 2019?
o: The AP Cabinet approved its withdrawal after the Centre advised reconsideration
The advice was linked to the replacement of the IPC and CrPC by the BNS and BNSS
The BNS and BNSS came into force on 1 July 2023
The BNS and BNSS replaced the IPC and CrPC
n704d9453805.x: The BNS and BNSS came into force on 1 July 2024.

nde45bd3929f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the NTR Bharosa Pension scheme?
o: It was earlier known as YSR Pension Kanuka (2019–24)
It was renamed NTR Bharosa from June 2024
The enhanced pension applies to old-age and widow beneficiaries
The monthly pension was enhanced from ₹3,000 to ₹5,000
nde45bd3929f.x: The pension was enhanced from ₹3,000 to ₹4,000 from April 2024.

n0e27f7437ee.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the health insurance model announced in Andhra Pradesh in May 2025?
o: It proposed coverage up to ₹25 lakh per family per year
It was meant only for families below the poverty line
It was intended for about 1.65 crore families
It was announced by Health Minister Y. Satya Kumar Yadav
n0e27f7437ee.x: The model was intended for poor and middle-class families, not only BPL families.

n3597b2e2a88.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about sanitation-related developments in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Swachh Andhra is one of the 10 Sutralu
A milestone of 500 ODF Plus villages was reported
The ODF Plus milestone was reported in January 2026
n3597b2e2a88.x: CLAP was launched on 2 October 2021, not on 15 August 2025.

nf0f539428ab.s:
Assertion (A): One Stop Centres under Mission Shakti are backed by Women Helpline 181.
Reason (R): Women Helpline 181 was universalised in 2024.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf0f539428ab.x: OSCs are backed by Helpline 181, but the helpline was universalised in 2019, not 2024.

n0f7679ad43f.s:
Assertion (A): YSR Kapu Nestham covers Kapu, Balija, Telaga and Ontari women aged 45–60 years.
Reason (R): YSR Kapu Nestham provides annual assistance of ₹15,000.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0f7679ad43f.x: Both are true, but the amount of assistance does not explain who is covered.

n40a8ba2100e.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the central NSAP pension amount is supplemented by:
o: The State government from its own funds
n40a8ba2100e.x: Andhra Pradesh tops up the central NSAP pension from State funds.

n6601780a97a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Polavaram Project?
o: It is a national project under Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
Its physical progress was 78.64 percent in December 2024
Its target year of completion is 2030
₹5,449 crore was provided for it in the 2024–25 Budget Estimate
n6601780a97a.x: Polavaram's target year of completion is 2027.

nb050b614fcc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about PMFBY?
o: The farmer premium for kharif crops is 2%
The farmer premium for rabi crops is 1.5%
The farmer premium for commercial and horticultural crops is 5%
It has been compulsory for all loanee farmers since Kharif 2020
nb050b614fcc.x: PMFBY has been voluntary for all farmers since Kharif 2020.

nc0660e1110b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024?
o: It targets 160 GW of clean energy
It aims for net zero by 2070
It seeks to make AP a global green hydrogen hub
nc0660e1110b.x: The policy aims for net zero by 2047.

n22164f2d5b7.s:
Assertion (A): The Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC) under the AP Crop Cultivators Rights Act, 2019 helps tenant farmers get loans, insurance and input subsidy.
Reason (R): The CCRC gives the tenant farmer ownership title over the leased land.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n22164f2d5b7.x: The CCRC gives access to loans, insurance and input subsidy without affecting the landowner's title, so R is false.

n752da75d237.s: Which of the following is wrongly matched?
o: Mixed economy – Public and private sectors operate side by side under State regulation
Underdeveloped economy – Public and private sectors operate side by side
Developing economy – High public investment in infrastructure is a precondition for private growth
Dual economy – Modern urban sector coexists with traditional subsistence sector
n752da75d237.x: An underdeveloped economy is marked by low per capita income, low capital formation, agricultural predominance and disguised unemployment; public-private coexistence describes a mixed economy.

n5fc7eb7ea20.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about types of economies?
o: In a command economy, custom and tradition decide what, how and for whom to produce
A socialist economy emphasises collective ownership and equitable distribution
The Gandhian model envisages decentralised, self-contained villages with cottage industries
Capitalism is marked by private ownership, market forces and economic inequality
n5fc7eb7ea20.x: In a command economy the government's central plan decides production; custom and tradition decide it in a traditional economy.

n6f8d6378e18.s: India's unorganised sector, which employs over 80% of workers, generates about ____ of national output.
n6f8d6378e18.x: The unorganised sector employs over 80% of workers but generates only about 45% of national output.

n6753278720f.s: In the activity-based classification, fisheries are classified as:
n6753278720f.x: Fisheries remain primary activities, like mining and quarrying in the activity-based classification.

nb7d9276a465.s: In 1951, agriculture accounted for about ____ of India's employment.
nb7d9276a465.x: Agriculture accounted for 72 per cent of employment in 1951.

n861471012ac.s: According to PLFS 2023–24 and the Economic Survey 2025–26, agriculture employs about ____ of India's workers.
n861471012ac.x: Agriculture employs about 46.1 per cent of workers while contributing about 18 per cent of GVA.

n49b15f90d70.s: The World Bank's income classification of countries is based on:
o: GDP per capita at purchasing power parity
GNI per capita by the Atlas method
GDP per capita at market prices
n49b15f90d70.x: The World Bank uses GNI per capita (Atlas method, three-year average inflation-adjusted exchange rate), revised every 1 July.

nindian-economy-57-16.x: Manufacturing is a secondary real-sector activity; agriculture is primary, and banking and bonds belong to the financial sector.

n296cd56a00b.s: India's demographic dividend is expected to peak around:
n296cd56a00b.x: The dividend is expected to peak around 2030; the median age is projected to reach about 36 by 2036.

n296cfd6b1c5.s: The estimate that India's share of world GDP fell from 22.6% in 1700 to 3.8% in 1952 is associated with:
n296cfd6b1c5.x: The 22.6% to 3.8% estimate is Angus Maddison's; Nurkse is known for the vicious circle of poverty.

nc169388132d.s: India's sex ratio in Census 2001 was:
nc169388132d.x: The sex ratio was 933 in 2001 and 940 in 2011; females were 48.46 per cent of the population in 2011.

nfc4833fb7c3.s: Private corporate investment in India fell to ____ of GDP in FY24 from 12.3% in FY23.
nfc4833fb7c3.x: Private corporate investment fell from 12.3% (FY23) to 11.2% (FY24); its share of GFCF hit a decadal low of 33%.

nindian-economy-57-18.s: A bank lending money is an example of activity in the:
nindian-economy-57-18.x: Lending is financial-sector activity; physical activity such as a farmer harvesting crops belongs to the real sector.

nindian-economy-57-12.s: Government ownership or control is the basic idea of the:
nindian-economy-57-12.x: Government ownership or control defines the public sector; private ownership or control defines the private sector.

nindian-economy-57-11.s: Money and financial assets are associated with the:
nindian-economy-57-11.x: Money and financial assets belong to the financial sector; the flow of goods and services belongs to the real sector.

nf314c93e94a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about models of structural change?
o: The three-sector model is associated with Allan Fisher and Colin Clark
The Clark-Fisher model predicts a shift from primary to tertiary and then to secondary activities
India deviates from Clark-Fisher as output shifted to services while labour stayed in agriculture
About 46% of India's workers remain in agriculture
nf314c93e94a.x: The Clark-Fisher sequence is primary to secondary to tertiary.

nindian-economy-26-4.s:
Assertion (A): Research, information and knowledge-based services belong to the quaternary sector.
Reason (R): Trade, hotels, transport and banking belong to the tertiary sector.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nindian-economy-26-4.x: Both classifications are correct, but the placing of trade and banking in the tertiary sector does not explain why knowledge services are quaternary.

n64ef0a0e485.s: In Andhra Pradesh's 2025-26 growth at constant prices, the fastest-growing sub-sector within agriculture and allied activities was:
n64ef0a0e485.x: Fishing and aquaculture grew fastest at 17.69%; overall, services (10.67%) grew faster than agriculture (10.14%) and industry (9.15%).

n801db1a551f.s: The dual-sector model of surplus farm labour (1954) was put forward by:
n801db1a551f.x: W. Arthur Lewis gave the model in 1954; the Lewis turning point comes when surplus farm labour is exhausted.

n7650c2ef5d7.s: The sector covering top decision-making, such as government policy and scientific research, is the:
n7650c2ef5d7.x: Top decision-making is the quinary sector; the quaternary sector is the knowledge sector.

n356c9b1b462.s: In the new GDP series with base year 2022-23, the share of manufacturing is:
n356c9b1b462.x: The new series puts manufacturing at 14.7 percent instead of 14.3 percent, with higher agriculture and industry shares and a lower services share.

nba518fd45d3.s: In 2021-22, India's primary sector contributed 21.82% of GDP but employed about ____ of the workforce.
nba518fd45d3.x: The primary sector employed 43.96% of workers; the tertiary sector had the highest GDP share at 53.89%.

n195037412bd.s: In the sectoral classification, trade is a ____ activity.
n195037412bd.x: Trade is tertiary, like transport and storage; water supply is secondary and mining primary.

nf15c13e2299.s: India accounts for about ____ of global manufacturing value added.
nf15c13e2299.x: India has about 2.9% of global manufacturing value added and 1.8% of merchandise exports, and ranks 44th on the Economic Complexity Index.

n1a61aaed139.s: Premature deindustrialisation may contribute to jobless growth in India because services:
o: can readily absorb all semi-skilled workers leaving farms
generate all new jobs in high-end IT and finance
generally require high skills and may not absorb semi-skilled farm workers
n1a61aaed139.x: Services often need high skills and may not absorb semi-skilled workers leaving agriculture, which can contribute to jobless growth.

nindian-economy-26-6.s: Public administration and defence are part of the:
nindian-economy-26-6.x: Services include trade, hotels, transport, communication, public administration and defence.

n5b1bde578c6.s: The quaternary sector is also known as the:
n5b1bde578c6.x: The quaternary sector is the knowledge sector; top decision-making is the quinary sector.

nindian-economy-26-7.x: Livestock comes under agriculture and allied activities; mining and quarrying count under industry.

n0cffced737a.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Trade, hotels and restaurants – Tertiary activity
Public administration and defence – Tertiary activity
Manufacturing, construction and utilities – Secondary activity
n0cffced737a.x: Forestry and fishing are primary activities.

n99135a14e3c.s: In 2021-22, the tertiary sector's share of India's GDP was about:
n99135a14e3c.x: The tertiary sector had 53.89% of GDP; its workforce share (33.80%) exceeded the secondary sector's (22.24%).

n2b7f308557c.s: Under the constitutional distribution of service subjects, electricity is in the:
n2b7f308557c.x: Electricity, education, accounting and engineering are in the Concurrent List; telecom, post and insurance are Union subjects; health and real estate are State subjects.

n33cbd52cc77.s: India's share of global services trade in 2024 was about:
n33cbd52cc77.x: India's share rose from about 2% in 2005 to 4.3% in 2024.

na46adae194b.s: The base year of MoSPI's trial Index of Services Production (ISP) is:
na46adae194b.x: The ISP is a monthly index released within 60 days, with base year 2024-25.

nda15d3a89ba.s: India's services sector produces more than half of output but employs only about ____ of workers.
nda15d3a89ba.x: This employment-output paradox: services give over half of output but only about one-third of jobs.

n42c009901f4.s: About what share of India's service-sector workers receive regular wages?
n42c009901f4.x: About 51.5% of service workers get regular wages, against about 1% in agriculture.

n7f7717acacf.s:
Assertion (A): The IT and ITES industry's contribution to broad-based development in India is limited.
Reason (R): The industry's skills and employment are concentrated among skilled workers and in a few cities.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n7f7717acacf.x: The industry earns foreign exchange and creates formal jobs, but its concentration among skilled workers and a few cities limits broad-based development.

n1e655a3e267.s: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) was set up under the Department of Electronics in:
n1e655a3e267.x: STPI was set up in 1991, giving export units satellite links and single-window clearances.

n8ccea41a2a7.s: According to NASSCOM, India's IT-BPM exports in FY2025 were about:
n8ccea41a2a7.x: Exports were about USD 224.4 billion (79% of USD 282.6 billion revenue); domestic revenue was only USD 58.2 billion.

nc12c97b10c1.s: Visa rules, protectionism and client spending cycles represent which aspect of India's IT-BPM industry?
nc12c97b10c1.x: All three are external factors on which the IT-BPM industry depends.

ndc3514b2bb3.s: India's largest software company and exporter is:
ndc3514b2bb3.x: TCS is the largest, followed by Infosys and Wipro.

nfed4d6d4a52.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Aarogyasri in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The name 'Rajiv Aarogyasri' honours Rajiv Gandhi
It was launched on 1 April 2007 in united Andhra Pradesh
It was open to all families irrespective of income
It was run through a state trust
nfed4d6d4a52.x: Aarogyasri was cashless health insurance for BPL families, not for all families.

n9f698f103ab.s: The 2025 insurance-law amendment raised the FDI cap in insurance from 74 per cent to:
n9f698f103ab.x: The cap went to 100 per cent; the amendment also changed the Insurance Act, LIC Act and IRDA Act and created a Policyholders' Education and Protection Fund.

n1c8c32355aa.s: General insurance in India was nationalised under the General Insurance Corporation in:
n1c8c32355aa.x: General insurance was nationalised in 1972; life insurance was nationalised when LIC was formed on 1 September 1956.

nf290353c533.s: India's public health spending was reported at about ____ of GDP.
nf290353c533.x: Public health spending was reported at 1.43% of GDP; 6% is the NEP 2020 target for education spending.

ne390101e1e5.s: IRDAI, the statutory insurance regulator set up under the IRDA Act, 1999, is headquartered at:
ne390101e1e5.x: IRDAI is headquartered in Hyderabad, not Mumbai.

n0cddf6dc0c8.s: The first UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) flight in April 2017 connected Delhi with:
n0cddf6dc0c8.x: UDAN was launched in 2016 and its first flight was Shimla-Delhi in April 2017.

n0afd7e89a47.s: PM-JAY, launched in 2018, provides health coverage of ____ per family.
n0afd7e89a47.x: PM-JAY gives Rs 5 lakh per family, and insurance coverage has roughly tripled since its launch.

n0c621321afe.x: P&I insurance covers shipowners' third-party liabilities; aviation hull covers aircraft damage and cyber insurance covers ransomware.

n28335683c58.x: 5G began on 1 October 2022, after BSNL's corporatisation (2000), the first UDAN flight (2017) and IPPB (2018).

nc28ecccaef9.s: Under the para-banking framework, a bank may distribute insurance products:
o: only as an unregulated informal intermediary
as a corporate agent or through a joint venture
only through a State-owned insurance corporation
only after converting into an NBFC
nc28ecccaef9.x: Banks may undertake insurance business as a corporate agent or through a joint venture, with regulatory approval.

n8e117b7e8ad.s: PM-JAY and State health schemes together cover about ____ of citizens.
n8e117b7e8ad.x: They cover about 80 per cent of citizens, but only about 35 per cent of those insured used the benefit.

nfb69a60d6cc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the unorganised sector and informal workers?
o: Under the Code on Social Security, 2020, unorganised workers include home-based, self-employed and wage workers
NCEUS defined the unorganised sector with a cut-off of fewer than 20 workers
An organised-sector worker without employment or social-security benefits is an informal worker
NCEUS's definition covers units owned by individuals or households
nfb69a60d6cc.x: NCEUS used a cut-off of fewer than 10 workers.

n71cc2b2b9a6.s:
Assertion (A): In Census 2011, Andhra Pradesh's share of cultivators (14.5%) was lower than India's (24.7%).
Reason (R): In Census 2011, Andhra Pradesh's share of all agricultural workers (62.4%) was higher than India's (54.6%).
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n71cc2b2b9a6.x: Both figures are correct, but a higher all-agriculture share does not explain a lower cultivator share.

n2ebd5a598ef.s: Which of the following pairs about India's slow shift of workers out of agriculture is correctly matched?
o: Capital-intensive growth – Absorbed surplus farm labour into formal jobs
Population pressure on land – Sharp fall in agriculture's employment share in the Plan era
Colonial deindustrialisation – Pushed artisans onto the land
Capital-intensive growth – Rapid movement of workers out of farming
n2ebd5a598ef.x: Colonial deindustrialisation pushed artisans onto the land; capital-intensive growth failed to absorb surplus farm labour, and agriculture's share fell only marginally in the Plan era.

n0ba9a7d07ef.s: In Census 2011, agricultural labourers formed ____ of India's workers.
n0ba9a7d07ef.x: Labourers were 30.0% and cultivators 24.7%; 2011 was the first Census in which labourers outnumbered cultivators.

neaba38ae639.s: Unemployment caused by a mismatch between skills and jobs is called:
neaba38ae639.x: Structural unemployment is a skills-jobs mismatch; frictional is a short gap between jobs and cyclical follows a business-cycle slump.

n860a9430e71.s: Women constituted about ____ of India's total employment in 2025.
n860a9430e71.x: Women were 32.5% of employment, and rural women gave 80% of the rise in female workers between 2017-18 and 2023-24.

nff04e35acf6.s: Despite contributing only about 18% of GVA in 2022–23, agriculture still employed about ____ of India's workforce.
nff04e35acf6.x: Agriculture employed 42.4% of workers; occupational structure changed much more slowly than output structure.

ndb40a44b9da.s: In the July 2026 monthly PLFS, the rural unemployment rate fell from 5% to:
ndb40a44b9da.x: Rural unemployment fell to 4.5% and the LFPR rose, though a fall may also reflect distress entry into low-productivity work.

nc0e2d330e4a.s: During 2011-2023, the share of direct employment in India's factory workforce fell from 61% to:
nc0e2d330e4a.x: Direct factory employment fell from 61% to 47% as firms sought flexibility; contract workers formed 42%.

nd3c0f39991a.s: Small and marginal farmers account for about ____ of India's farmers.
nd3c0f39991a.x: Small and marginal farmers are about 86%; 57.8% is the share of rural households that are agricultural households.

ncf477abfa80.s: The four Labour Codes consolidated how many earlier labour laws?
ncf477abfa80.x: Twenty-nine laws were consolidated; the Code on Wages came in 2019 and the other three Codes in 2020.

n08cbd761122.s: In Andhra Pradesh, agricultural labourers outnumbered cultivators in the ratio of about:
n08cbd761122.x: In AP labourers outnumbered cultivators about 3:1, against about 1.2:1 for India.

n43aa2647beb.s: Under PLFS 2023–24, agriculture accounted for about ____ of employment in Andhra Pradesh.
n43aa2647beb.x: Agriculture was 45.6 per cent of AP employment, close to India's 46.1 per cent.

ne6d10286610.s: About what share of female workers were agricultural labourers?
ne6d10286610.x: Among female workers, 55% were agricultural labourers and 24% were cultivators.

n06b0cb9defe.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Second Five Year Plan?
o: Investment was raised from 7% to 11% of national income
Long gestation periods contributed to a high ICOR
It emphasised light, labour-intensive consumer industries
The high ICOR kept growth lower than expected
n06b0cb9defe.x: The Second Plan emphasised heavy and capital-intensive industries.

nf8646c9ed3b.s:
Assertion (A): Indira Gandhi raised the slogan 'Garibi Hatao' in 1969, along with bank nationalisation.
Reason (R): The nationalisation of 14 banks in July 1969 aimed to extend credit to agriculture and priority sectors.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf8646c9ed3b.x: 'Garibi Hatao' was raised in 1971, not 1969, so A is false; R correctly states the aim of the 1969 nationalisation.

nd19edb758ba.s: Schedule B of the Industrial Policy Resolution, 1956 listed how many industries?
nd19edb758ba.x: Schedule B had 12 industries; Schedule A reserved 17 for the State, cut to 8 in 1991.

nc6b1a9db25c.s: In 2025–26, Andhra Pradesh recorded a growth rate of ____, against India's 7.4 per cent.
nc6b1a9db25c.x: AP grew 9.88 per cent against India's 7.4 per cent, and has outgrown India in most years since 2014–15.

nc172117547e.s: The Indian economy recorded its post-reform peak growth rate of 8.5 per cent during:
nc172117547e.x: Growth peaked at 8.5 per cent during 2003–08; post-reform growth averaged about 6.5 per cent.

n00548b6d079.s: The term 'Hindu rate of growth' was coined in 1978 by:
n00548b6d079.x: Prof. Raj Krishna coined it in 1978 for India's real GDP growth of about 3.5% from the 1950s to 1980.

nindian-economy-4-11.s: The National Rural Employment Programme was launched in:
nindian-economy-4-11.x: NREP came in 1980; IDBI was 1964, the Dandekar–Rath study 1971 and the first Food-for-Work programme 1977–78.

n9d6d3e8efcf.s: Rodrik and Subramanian (2004) described the attitudinal shift behind India's growth transition around 1980 as:
n9d6d3e8efcf.x: They called the 1980s shift pro-business, not pro-market; DeLong (2003) also placed the take-off in the 1980s.

nindian-economy-4-7.s: The Reserve Bank of India was nationalised on 1 January:
nindian-economy-4-7.x: RBI was nationalised on 1 January 1949; IFCI came in 1948 and the First Plan in 1951.

nindian-economy-4-9.s: The State Bank of India was set up in:
nindian-economy-4-9.x: SBI dates from 1955; the Community Development Programme was 1952, the Second Industrial Policy 1956 and IDBI 1964.

nindian-economy-4-4.s: The first Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) was set up in:
nindian-economy-4-4.x: The first KVK dates from 1974; the first RRB was 1975, NABARD 1982 and the first private mutual fund 1993.

o: Change in output ÷ change in capital
Change in output ÷ change in labour
Change in capital ÷ change in output
nd064d4a369f.x: ICOR is the extra capital needed per unit of extra output; a lower ICOR means more efficient investment.

nindian-economy-4-12.s: The Integrated Rural Development Programme (IRDP), tried experimentally in 1978–79, was implemented nationwide in:
nindian-economy-4-12.x: IRDP went national in 1980, the year of the second bank nationalisation.

nf5c411261ce.s:
Assertion (A): Four-fifths of the members of a Metropolitan Planning Committee are elected.
Reason (R): Four-fifths of the members of a District Planning Committee are elected by and from the elected members of the district panchayat and municipalities.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf5c411261ce.x: In an MPC two-thirds of members are elected; four-fifths is the DPC figure, so A is false and R is true.

na65cefc9288.s: The draft district plan consolidated by the District Planning Committee is forwarded to the State Government by the:
o: Chief Executive Officer of the Zila Parishad
na65cefc9288.x: The DPC chairperson forwards the draft district plan, consolidated from Panchayat and Municipal plans, to the State Government.

n43835e360e2.s: The apex body that approved the draft Five Year Plan was the:
n43835e360e2.x: The NDC approved the draft; the Planning Commission assessed resources and prepared it, and the Finance Ministry gave budgetary allocation.

n78e6e3347fe.s: The Chairman of a State Planning Board is the:
n78e6e3347fe.x: The Chief Minister chairs the State Planning Board and submitted the State draft plan to the Planning Commission.

n39a33915784.s: The Thungon sub-committee (1988) made which body the pivot of planning?
n39a33915784.x: The Thungon sub-committee made the Zila Parishad, not the Gram Sabha, the pivot of planning.

nindian-economy-23-2.s: The Finance Commission is a constitutional body under Article:
nindian-economy-23-2.x: The Finance Commission is under Article 280; the Planning Commission (1950) and NITI Aayog (2015) were set up by Cabinet resolutions.

n90767d109a4.s: Metropolitan Planning Committees are provided for under Article:
n90767d109a4.x: MPCs are under Article 243ZE; DPCs are under Article 243ZD.

n3a9456d4d7f.s: The National Development Council is a:
n3a9456d4d7f.x: The NDC is neither constitutional nor statutory, works in an advisory capacity, and its recommendations are not binding.

nfa7f5533e81.s: The Congress National Planning Committee, initiated by Subhas Chandra Bose, was chaired by:
nfa7f5533e81.x: Jawaharlal Nehru chaired the committee; its final report came in 1949.

n54d0bf019db.s:
Assertion (A): The National Development Council was set up in 1950, along with the Planning Commission.
Reason (R): The NDC was an extra-constitutional apex body that finally approved the Five Year Plans.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n54d0bf019db.x: The Planning Commission came on 15 March 1950 but the NDC in 1952, so A is false; R is true.

na99023323d4.s: The concept of the 'rolling plan' for developing countries was suggested by:
na99023323d4.x: Gunnar Myrdal suggested it; the Janata government ran a rolling plan from April 1978 to March 1980.

n48b074df22d.s: In the financing of India's Five Year Plans, 'deficit financing' meant:
o: Borrowing from the RBI, that is, money creation
n48b074df22d.x: Deficit financing was borrowing from the RBI; foreign aid and domestic savings (including market borrowing and PSU surpluses) were the other sources.

n8c271f451ad.s: Planning that works through binding quotas and allocation is called:
n8c271f451ad.x: Imperative planning uses binding quotas; indicative planning only guides the private sector.

nb43f3dc64ce.s: The target-group approach in Indian planning began with the:
nb43f3dc64ce.x: It began with the Fourth Plan (1969), with programmes like SFDA, MFAL and DPAP; IRDP came in the Sixth Plan.

n6669b4ab053.s: The First Five Year Plan (from 1 April 1951) gave the highest priority to:
n6669b4ab053.x: Facing foodgrain imports and inflation, the First Plan gave top priority to agriculture.

n83ea8f36d1d.s: Allocation of resources in real terms (materials, manpower and output targets) is called:
n83ea8f36d1d.x: Physical planning allocates in real terms; allocation in money terms is financial planning.

n8e897c381e8.s: How many districts does the Amaravati Economic Region of Andhra Pradesh comprise?
n8e897c381e8.x: The Visakhapatnam, Amaravati and Tirupati Economic Regions have 10, 9 and 10 districts respectively.

n393284df603.s: The Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission held the rank of a:
o: Secretary to the Government of India
n393284df603.x: The Deputy Chairman was the de facto head, with Cabinet-minister rank, attending Cabinet meetings without a vote.

n0b41c976f06.s: Which of the following is one of the four long-term objectives of Indian planning?
n0b41c976f06.x: The four long-term objectives are growth, modernisation, self-reliance and social justice.

n5cd142457ba.s: In India's multi-level planning, the planning body at the district level is the:
n5cd142457ba.x: Planning runs through NITI Aayog (Centre), Planning Boards (States), DPCs (districts) and GPDPs at the village level.

n85b1fe7d79f.s: NITI Aayog lacks financial powers and is associated with:
n85b1fe7d79f.x: NITI Aayog has no financial powers and marks a shift to cooperative and competitive federalism.

n1e7aa2ba152.s: The Fifth Five Year Plan aimed at self-reliance and:
o: Raising the consumption of the poor
n1e7aa2ba152.x: The Fifth Plan aimed at self-reliance and higher consumption of the poor; the Fourth emphasised weaker sections.

nbb0ad049259.s: The Janata Government, after ending the Fifth Plan a year early, adopted a Rolling Plan for:
nbb0ad049259.x: The Rolling Plan covered 1978–80, following a concept advocated by Gunnar Myrdal.

n64db007e22e.s: The Advisory Planning Board of 1946 was headed by:
n64db007e22e.x: K.C. Neogi headed the 1946 board; Mahalanobis was architect of the Second Plan and founded the ISI in 1931.

n2e50bba9fc9.s: The Second Five Year Plan model, which saw scarcity of capital goods as the main bottleneck, is also called the:
n2e50bba9fc9.x: It is the Feldman-Mahalanobis model; the Harrod-Domar model saw limited savings as the bottleneck.

ne47e9361a8d.s: The first round of the National Sample Survey, recommended by the National Income Committee, was held in:
ne47e9361a8d.x: The first NSS round was in 1950–51; Mahalanobis chaired the National Income Committee (1949).

o: Doubling per capita income in 15 years
Doubling national income within a decade
Trebling national income within a decade
n23efa2c8e40.x: Visvesvaraya's plan aimed to double national income in a decade through industrialisation; trebling in 15 years was the Bombay Plan.

n04aca12d2c0.s: Stalin's USSR, whose system is described as imperative planning, began five-year plans in:
n04aca12d2c0.x: The USSR began five-year plans in 1928; India follows indicative planning.

o: Foreign trade as the central source of growth
n38838d67755.x: The model assumed a closed economy and neglected agriculture; foreign trade was not central to it.

nindian-economy-68-22.s: A high Capital Output Ratio means that investment produces:
o: faster growth from the same savings
nindian-economy-68-22.x: With a high COR each unit of investment yields relatively little output, so even high savings may give slow growth.

n4fd23bda23b.s: The wage-goods model in India's planning experience focused on:
n4fd23bda23b.x: Harrod–Domar focused on savings, Mahalanobis on capital goods and the wage-goods model on food.

n089d6e1b112.s: In the Harrod-Domar model, other factors remaining constant, growth rises when:
n089d6e1b112.x: Growth depends positively on the savings rate and negatively on the capital-output ratio.

n90c36c2b371.s: Which of the following was emphasised in the Janata Government's alternative strategy?
n90c36c2b371.x: The Janata strategy stressed agriculture, rural development, employment, small and cottage industries and minimum needs rather than heavy industry.

n536c7cd574c.s: Which model prioritised agriculture and wage goods?
n536c7cd574c.x: The wage-goods model favoured agriculture and wage goods; Mahalanobis prioritised heavy industry and capital goods.

nda0e9bacdae.s: The People's Plan (1945) was prepared by:
nda0e9bacdae.x: M.N. Roy prepared the People's Plan in 1945; the Bombay Plan, Gandhian Plan and Dalal's Planning and Development Department belong to 1944.

nc097f2e9a63.s:
Assertion (A): The Third Five Year Plan aimed at a self-reliant and self-generating economy.
Reason (R): The Fourth Five Year Plan aimed at growth with stability and progressive achievement of self-reliance.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nc097f2e9a63.x: Both describe the Plans correctly, but a later Plan's objective cannot explain the Third Plan's aim.

n9e099bb5bae.s: During the Twelfth Plan, the plan/non-plan distinction was reviewed by the:
n9e099bb5bae.x: The Rangarajan Committee reviewed it; the Twelfth Plan also cut the number of CSS, gave a flexi-fund and promoted social-sector PPPs.

n87c25c23e27.s: Among the failures of Indian planning, regional imbalance persisted:
n87c25c23e27.x: Regional imbalance existed both across and within States, along with poverty, inequality and lagging employment growth.

n03ad44206ae.s: Under the Gadgil–Mukherjee formula, population carried a weight of:
n03ad44206ae.x: Population got 60 percent, per capita income 25 percent, and fiscal performance and special problems 7.5 percent each.

n8304bccce25.s: Average growth over the First to Eleventh Plans was about ____, against roughly 1 per cent before Independence.
n8304bccce25.x: Plan-period growth averaged about 4.5%; agriculture grew 2-3% and industry about 6-8%.

nindian-economy-22-4.s: 'Growth with social justice' was the objective of the:
nindian-economy-22-4.x: The Ninth Plan aimed at growth with social justice; the First focused on agriculture, the Fourth on growth with stability and the Sixth on poverty reduction.

n5a9ce601fef.s: During the Eleventh Plan, Andhra Pradesh targeted 9.5 percent GSDP growth but achieved:
n5a9ce601fef.x: AP achieved 5.28 percent GSDP growth; its industrial growth was 7.26 percent against a 10 percent target.

nf3dc7211049.s: The Green Revolution began during the Plan Holiday in:
nf3dc7211049.x: The Green Revolution began in 1966–67, when only Annual Plans were implemented.

n36a1febec11.s: The Twenty-Point Programme was introduced during the:
n36a1febec11.x: The Twenty-Point Programme and the Minimum Needs Programme came in the Fifth Plan; DPAP in the Fourth.

nb703a51a639.s: The first Five Year Plan to set monitorable targets was the:
nb703a51a639.x: The Tenth Plan (2002-07) first set monitorable targets; the Eleventh extended them.

n39a56a61983.s: Employment was the main thrust of the:
n39a56a61983.x: The Seventh Plan's thrust was employment; the First stressed agriculture and irrigation, the Second heavy industry and the Sixth power.

n9a846dfc499.s: The Food Corporation of India was established in:
n9a846dfc499.x: FCI was set up in 1965 and, with the Green Revolution and National Seeds Corporation, aided food self-sufficiency.

n5cbb34fda53.s: After the Annual Plans of 1990–91 and 1991–92, the Eighth Five Year Plan began in:
n5cbb34fda53.x: The Eighth Plan began in 1992 after two Annual Plans.

n341837fee7d.s: The Five Year Plan system in India ended in:
n341837fee7d.x: Five Year Plans ended in 2017, though plan-style credit and regional planning continue.

n25662c341e4.s: Of the Eleventh Plan's 27 national monitorable targets, how many were set at the State level?
n25662c341e4.x: The Eleventh Plan set 27 national monitorable targets, including 13 at the State level.
